issues.description: The problem statement and UML require addGuestStudents(int, String) (an int plus a reason String), but the solution implementation provides addGuestStudents(int) with only a single int parameter. This mismatch between the specified method signature and the solution implementation can confuse students about the expected API and will cause issues if tests or instructions expect the two-parameter form.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's method signature match the specification. Change the solution implementation to public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, String reason) and update the body to add the provided number to numberOfGuestStudents (and optionally record or log the reason). Alternatively, if the reason parameter is not needed pedagogically, update the problem statement and UML to specify addGuestStudents(int) to keep all artifacts consistent.
